transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.description: Move money between your accounts, or record money sent to or received from a person

hint.account: Not counted as income or expense: the money only changes accounts.
hint.person: Moves the amount from the source person and account to the destination person and account. It doesn't count as income or expense, but it changes each person's balance.
hint.balance: Empties the source account into the other one, negative balances included. Pick a person to move only their share.

balancePreview.label: Will transfer

errors.sameAccount: Pick a destination account different from the source
errors.samePersonAccount: Pick a different destination person or account

pastInstallments.description: The first installment would be due on {dueDate}, which has already passed. Do you want to add all {total} installments (including the already-due ones) or only the {upcoming} still-upcoming ones?

initialBalance.title: Initial balance
initialBalance.description: This transaction represents an account's opening balance — it isn't edited as a regular transaction. Adjust the amount from the Accounts screen.

investmentMovement.title: Investment movement
investmentMovement.description: This transaction is a contribution, withdrawal, or yield — it's managed from the investment account's own screen, not as a regular transaction.

loanInstallment.title: Loan installment
loanInstallment.description: This transaction is a loan installment payment — it's managed from the loan's own screen, not as a regular transaction.

invoicePayment.title: Invoice payment
invoicePayment.description: This transaction is a card invoice payment — it's managed from the invoice's own screen, not as a regular transaction.

transfer.title: Transfer between accounts
transfer.description: This transaction is one of the two ends of a transfer between your accounts. So one end is never left without the other, it isn't edited like a regular entry — delete it and record the transfer again; both ends are removed together.
